GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Good night
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Please

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking, Listening for Information.

3. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Schule
   C. Wasser
   D. Haus

4. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

5. When practising Oral Expression, Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression, Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression, Active Listening.

6. When practising Oral Expression, Active listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression, Active listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression, Active listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression, Active listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression, Active listening.

7. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
